```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

# Load the CSV data
df <- read_csv("mangrove_products.csv")

# Filter out rows with missing lat-long and convert to sf object
df_sf <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Latitude), !is.na(Longitude), !is.na(Location)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

# Group data by Location and Product Types (Category), then aggregate sellers and products for popup
df_grouped <- df_sf %>%
  group_by(Location, Latitude, Longitude) %>%
  summarise(
    popup_info = {
      category_groups <- group_split(cur_data(), `Product Types`)
      popup_strings <- map_chr(category_groups, function(cat_df) {
        category_name <- unique(cat_df$`Product Types`)
        sellers_info <- cat_df %>%
          group_by(Seller) %>%
          summarise(
            products = str_c(`Product Name`, collapse = ", "),
            links = str_c(
              "<a href='", Link, "' target='_blank'>Link</a>",
              collapse = ", "
            ),
            .groups = "drop"
          )
        # Create the rows for sellers in this category
        sellers_rows <- str_c(
          "<tr><td>", sellers_info$Seller, "</td><td>", sellers_info$products, "</td><td>", sellers_info$links, "</td></tr>",
          collapse = ""
        )
        # Wrap rows in a table with category heading
        str_c("<strong>Category: </strong>", category_name,
          "<table border='1' style='border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; font-size:12px;'>",
          "<thead><tr><th>Seller</th><th>Products</th><th>Links</th></tr></thead>",
          "<tbody>", sellers_rows, "</tbody></table><br>")
      })
      str_c(popup_strings, collapse = "")
    },
    product_type_for_color = first(`Product Types`),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

# Define custom colors for specific product types including 'Others'
custom_colors <- c(
  "Cosmetics" = "#E7298A", 
  "Food products" = "#FF7F00", 
  "Textile" = "#6A3D9A", 
  "Others" = "#B1A866"
)

# Get unique product types
product_types <- unique(df_sf$`Product Types`)

# Generate default colors (large enough palette)
default_colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))(length(product_types))

# Map colors: use custom colors if defined, else default colors
mapped_colors <- sapply(product_types, function(pt) {
  if (pt %in% names(custom_colors)) {
    custom_colors[[pt]]
  } else {
    default_colors[(which(product_types == pt) - 1) %% length(default_colors) + 1]
  }
})

# Create color factor function for mapping colors to product types
colors <- colorFactor(palette = mapped_colors, domain = product_types)

# Create the leaflet map
map <- leaflet(df_grouped) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(radius = 7,
                   color = ~colors(product_type_for_color),
                   stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.8,
                   popup = ~popup_info) %>%
  addMouseCoordinates() %>%
  addMiniMap(tiles = providers$OpenStreetMap, position = "bottomleft") %>%
  addLegend("bottomright", pal = colors, values = product_types,
            title = "Product Types", opacity = 1)

# Render the map with smaller legend text style
htmltools::browsable(
  htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::tags$style(HTML(
      ".leaflet .legend { font-size: 8px; line-height: 10px; }"
    )),
    map
  )
)


library(htmlwidgets)

# Assuming your leaflet map object is named 'map'
saveWidget(map,
           file = "index.html",
           selfcontained = T,
           libdir = "mangrove_products_only")


```

```{r}
# Only install if not already available
if (!require("maps")) install.packages("maps")
library(maps)

# Load data
mangrove_products <- read.csv("mangrove_products.csv")

# Define map boundaries
min_lon <- 90
max_lon <- 150
min_lat <- -15
max_lat <- 15

# Open PDF device to save output
pdf("mangrove_products_map_updated.pdf", width = 10, height = 7)

# Save old plotting settings
old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)

# Use exact axis limits with no expansion padding
par(xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")

# Plot blank with ocean fill blue exactly within axis limits
plot(NA, xlim = c(min_lon, max_lon), ylim = c(min_lat, max_lat),
     type = "n", xlab = "", ylab = "", axes = FALSE)
rect(min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat, col = "lightblue", border = NA)

# Plot land polygons filled grey on top
map("world", xlim = c(min_lon, max_lon), ylim = c(min_lat, max_lat),
    col = "grey85", fill = TRUE, add = TRUE)

# Add grid lines every 4 degrees
abline(v = seq(min_lon, max_lon, by = 4), col = "grey70", lty = 3)
abline(h = seq(min_lat, max_lat, by = 4), col = "grey70", lty = 3)

# Draw axes with tick labels every 4 degrees
axis(1, at = seq(min_lon, max_lon, by = 4),
     labels = paste0(seq(min_lon, max_lon, by = 4), "°E"), cex.axis = 0.7)
axis(2, at = seq(min_lat, max_lat, by = 4),
     labels = paste0(abs(seq(min_lat, max_lat, by = 4)),
                     ifelse(seq(min_lat, max_lat, by = 4) < 0, "°S", "°N")),
     cex.axis = 0.7)

# Define point colors by product type
product_colors <- c(
  "Cosmetics" = "#008000",     # green
  "Food products" = "#0000FF", # blue
  "Textile" = "#FFA500",       # orange
  "Others" = "#800080"         # purple
)
pt_colors <- product_colors[as.character(mangrove_products$Product.Types)]

# Plot mangrove product points
points(mangrove_products$Longitude, mangrove_products$Latitude,
       pch = 21, bg = pt_colors, col = pt_colors, cex = 1.5)

# Add legend with white background at bottom right
legend("bottomright",
       legend = names(product_colors),
       pt.bg = product_colors,
       pch = 21, col = "black", cex = 0.8,
       bg = "white")

# Add scale bar at bottom left
scalebar_length <- 200
scalebar_x <- min_lon + 1
scalebar_y <- min_lat + 1
rect(scalebar_x, scalebar_y, scalebar_x + 2, scalebar_y + 0.2, col = "black")
text(scalebar_x + 1, scalebar_y - 0.5, paste0(scalebar_length, " km"),
     adj = 0.3, cex = 0.5)

# Add north arrow (top right) without overlap
north_x <- max_lon - 1
north_N_y <- max_lat - 0.8
text(north_x, north_N_y, "N", cex = 0.7, font = 12)



```
